dialogue.content: こんばんわ
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for meeting with me.

dialogue.content: 今気づきました
dialogue.English: I just saw your message.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: I look forward to our session as well.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 夫のことなんですが、、
dialogue.English: It's about my husband...

dialogue.content: 浮気しているみたいなんです
dialogue.English: I think he might be cheating on me.

dialogue.content: 夫さん・・どのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Your husband... what is it you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: ええ！！
dialogue.English: Oh!!

dialogue.content: それは！！
dialogue.English: That's...!

dialogue.content: ひどいです
dialogue.English: That's terrible.

dialogue.content: はい、まだ確証はないんですが、なんだか様子が変で、、、
dialogue.English: Yes, I don't have any solid proof yet, but he's just been acting strange...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 残業や休日出勤が以前より頻繁で、、
dialogue.English: He’s been working overtime and on weekends more often than before...

dialogue.content: 前より素っ気ない感じです
dialogue.English: And he seems more distant than he used to be.

dialogue.content: それは妻としては！！
dialogue.English: As his wife, that must be...!!

dialogue.content: そっけないとは、具体的にどんな風にかお聞かせ願えますか？
dialogue.English: Could you please tell me specifically in what ways he seems distant?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Well...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 休みの日に一緒に出掛けるとつまらなそうだったり
dialogue.English: When we go out together on his days off, he looks bored, or...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: LINEの返事も事務的な感じで、、
dialogue.English: His replies on LINE feel very businesslike...

dialogue.content: 事務的なのですか・・
dialogue.English: Business-like, you say...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 気持ちがこもってないような
dialogue.English: Like there's no feeling behind them.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からとかございますか？
dialogue.English: Do you know about when this started?

dialogue.content: 変わったと思われる事・・
dialogue.English: When you started noticing these changes...

dialogue.content: 3ヶ月くらい前からでしょうか
dialogue.English: Maybe about three months ago.

dialogue.content: 三か月もですか！！
dialogue.English: For three months?!

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 何かそのころ心当たりはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything around that time that comes to mind?

dialogue.content: 心当たりですか？
dialogue.English: Something that comes to mind?

dialogue.content: 夫さんに何か変化といいますか
dialogue.English: I mean, any changes with your husband.

dialogue.content: 気がついたらそんな感じだったので
dialogue.English: It was more like I just noticed it was happening at some point.

dialogue.content: ふだんと変わらない日々だったところ、自然に・・・という事なのでしょうか
dialogue.English: So things were normal, and then it just started happening gradually... is that right?

dialogue.content: そうですね、そんな感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's what it feels like.

dialogue.content: だんだん帰りが遅くなって行ったりしました
dialogue.English: He gradually started coming home later and later.

dialogue.content: 心配もされたでしょうね
dialogue.English: You must have been worried.

dialogue.content: うーん、不安になってますね
dialogue.English: Mmm, I've been feeling anxious.

dialogue.content: 遅くなった理由は何とおっしゃられましたか
dialogue.English: What reasons did he give for coming home late?

dialogue.content: 仕事だと言っています
dialogue.English: He says it’s work.

dialogue.content: そうですか、仕事と言われてもやはり不
dialogue.English: I see. Even if he says it’s work, you still feel un-

dialogue.content: 失礼しました
dialogue.English: My apologies.

dialogue.content: 不安になりなすよね
dialogue.English: It makes you feel anxious, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、
dialogue.English: Yes, it does...

dialogue.content: あなたは不審に感じる・・のですものね
dialogue.English: You’re feeling suspicious, after all.

dialogue.content: そっけなくて気持ちがこもってなくて帰りが遅いと不安になりますよね
dialogue.English: When he’s distant, lacks warmth, and comes home late, it’s natural to feel anxious.

dialogue.content: 昔はどんな夫様でしたか？
dialogue.English: What was your husband like before?

dialogue.content: モヤモヤするけどどうしたらいいか分からなくて
dialogue.English: I feel so unsettled, but I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: モヤモヤ、しますね
dialogue.English: Yes, it's very unsettling.

dialogue.content: 優しくていつも私のことを考えてくれて良い夫でした。
dialogue.English: He was kind and always thoughtful towards me; he was a good husband.

dialogue.content: そうなのですか・・。尚更、寂しく感じますよね
dialogue.English: Is that so... That must make you feel even more lonely now.

dialogue.content: ちなみに
dialogue.English: By the way,

dialogue.content: ご結婚されて何年になりますか？
dialogue.English: How many years have you been married?

dialogue.content: 5年です
dialogue.English: Five years.

dialogue.content: そうですか！！それは、まだ新婚と言っても過言ではないほどですものね
dialogue.English: I see! It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say you're still practically newlyweds.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、
dialogue.English: I suppose so...

dialogue.content: あなたのその想いは伝えたこと等は・・
dialogue.English: Have you ever tried to tell him how you feel...?

dialogue.content: ございますか？
dialogue.English: Have you?

dialogue.content: いえ、何もいえなくて、、
dialogue.English: No, I haven’t been able to say anything...

dialogue.content: 言えないのはどのようなお気持ちからですか？
dialogue.English: What feelings are stopping you from saying something?

dialogue.content: もし本当に浮気していたらショックで、、
dialogue.English: If he really is cheating, I'd be so devastated...

dialogue.content: ええ！そうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, of course you would be.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 悪い方ばかり考えてしまう感じですか？
dialogue.English: Do you find yourself thinking of the worst-case scenario?

dialogue.content: はい、ネガティブになってしまいます
dialogue.English: Yes, I tend to think negatively.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、怖いですよね。ちなみに夫さんは奥様のそんな気持ちに気づいておられるのでしょうか・・
dialogue.English: I understand, it's frightening. By the way, do you think your husband has noticed how you're feeling?

dialogue.content: いえ、多分気づいてないんじゃないかな、、
dialogue.English: No, I don't think he's noticed...

dialogue.content: そんな不安な中お二人はどのように過ごされていますか？
dialogue.English: With all this anxiety, how do the two of you spend your time together?

dialogue.content: 日々淡々とですね、、ただ一緒にいるだけみたいな
dialogue.English: We just go through the motions day by day... It's like we're just physically in the same space.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね！心が苦しくなりますね。最近一緒に行動されたのはいつ頃が最後ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds heartbreaking. When was the last time you did something together?

dialogue.content: 先週の日曜ですね
dialogue.English: Last Sunday.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 一緒に買い物に行ってました
dialogue.English: We went shopping together.

dialogue.content: ちなみにどのような買い物を？
dialogue.English: What kind of shopping, if I may ask?

dialogue.content: 日用品の買い出しですね
dialogue.English: Just buying daily necessities.

dialogue.content: そうですか。会話にも異変はかんじられますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you notice anything different about your conversations?

dialogue.content: なんか心が篭ってないというか、心ここにあらずって感じです
dialogue.English: It's like his heart isn't in it, like his mind is somewhere else.

dialogue.content: 以前はもっと笑ったりしてたんですが
dialogue.English: He used to laugh more.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 楽しそうじゃないっていうか
dialogue.English: It's like he's not enjoying himself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一緒にいても寂しくなります
dialogue.English: I feel lonely even when we’re together.

dialogue.content: 寂しいしむなしいと思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: You must feel lonely and empty, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 女性の影は感じられますか？
dialogue.English: Do you sense the presence of another woman?

dialogue.content: 浮気しているとは思っています
dialogue.English: I do believe he is cheating.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね？それは、どうゆう事からなのですか？
dialogue.English: You do? What makes you think so?

dialogue.content: 今までお話ししたことからそう思っています
dialogue.English: I think so based on everything I've told you so far.

dialogue.content: 帰りが遅い、残業、そっけない、つまらなそう、笑顔もなくなったという所ですよね
dialogue.English: You mean coming home late, the overtime, being distant, looking bored, and not smiling anymore, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 女の勘ですね
dialogue.English: A woman’s intuition, then.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 明らかに態度が違うので
dialogue.English: His attitude is clearly different.

dialogue.content: そうですね！あなた想いの優しい夫さんが急にそうなると。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can see that. For your kind and thoughtful husband to suddenly change like that.

dialogue.content: とても苦しいですよね
dialogue.English: It must be very painful.

dialogue.content: ちなみにお子様はいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, do you have any children?

dialogue.content: いえ、いません
dialogue.English: No, we don’t.

dialogue.content: お子様がいらっしゃらない事にかんしてはお二人でお話はされた事はあるのですよね
dialogue.English: Have the two of you talked about not having children?

dialogue.content: お互い子供はいらないと同意しています
dialogue.English: We've both agreed that we don't want children.

dialogue.content: そうですか。あなたも夫さんもお子さんはいらないと話もされているのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So both you and your husband have discussed not wanting children.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 2人で結婚前にそのことについては話しました
dialogue.English: We talked about it before we got married.

dialogue.content: ええ。そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: I understand. I see.

dialogue.content: お子様は欲しくないお二人なのですね
dialogue.English: So neither of you wants children.

dialogue.content: 今後、このままではとても苦しいですね
dialogue.English: It will be very difficult for you if things continue like this.

dialogue.content: はい、毎日辛いです
dialogue.English: Yes, every day is painful.

dialogue.content: でもはっきりさせるのも怖いし
dialogue.English: But it's also scary to find out the truth.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 夫さんとあなた
dialogue.English: You and your husband...

dialogue.content: の共通の趣味や好みはございますか？
dialogue.English: do you have any shared hobbies or interests?

dialogue.content: 美味しいものを食べに行くのが好きです
dialogue.English: We like to go out to eat delicious food.

dialogue.content: おお！！素敵ですね！美味しいもの食べるのが二人の共通なのですね
dialogue.English: Oh!! That's wonderful! Eating delicious food is something you both enjoy.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今はいけてますか？
dialogue.English: Have you been able to do that lately?

dialogue.content: お休みの日には行っています
dialogue.English: We go on days off.

dialogue.content: 彼が仕事がなければ
dialogue.English: If he doesn’t have work.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・仕事でいけない事もあるのですね
dialogue.English: I see... So sometimes you can't go because of his work.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 前はほぼ毎週末行けてたんですが
dialogue.English: We used to be able to go almost every weekend, but...

dialogue.content: 最近はいけない時もあります
dialogue.English: Recently there are times we can’t.

dialogue.content: 仕事だと言われると何もいえなくて
dialogue.English: When he says it’s work, I can’t say anything.

dialogue.content: そうですよね！！もし本当にあなたの勘が当たっていて浮気だとしても、あなたは夫さんをとても想って
dialogue.English: That's right!! Even if your intuition is correct and it's an affair, you care so much about your husband.

dialogue.content: 想っておられるので、二人の共通の楽しみの食事にはめげずに出かけて欲しいですね
dialogue.English: So, I hope you keep going out for those shared enjoyable meals without getting discouraged.

dialogue.content: どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: 一緒に出かけるのが楽しみなので、前みたいに戻って欲しいです
dialogue.English: I enjoy going out together, so I want things to go back to how they were.

dialogue.content: ええ戻って欲しいです。普通うだったら
dialogue.English: Yes, you want things to go back. Normally...

dialogue.content: 問い詰めたり、怒ったりするのに、あなたは彼を想ってお方だとおもいます
dialogue.English: ...most people would confront him or get angry, but I think you're someone who is very considerate of him.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、彼のためというより、ハッキリさせて今より状況が悪化するのを避けている感じですかね
dialogue.English: Well... rather than it being for his sake, I feel like I'm trying to avoid making the situation worse than it already is by confronting him.

dialogue.content: 彼を想って、待てるお方だと。お辛いでしょうが、優しかった夫さんには問い詰めない優しいあなたが
dialogue.English: You're someone who can wait because you care for him. It must be painful, but because you are gentle and don't confront the husband who was once so kind...

dialogue.content: あなたに気持ちも含め戻って来られるのではないかなと。
dialogue.English: ...I feel like he might come back to you, feelings and all.

dialogue.content: 普通でしたらとっくに悪化してますよね
dialogue.English: In a normal situation, things would have gotten much worse by now, wouldn't they?

dialogue.content: 遅くなってます。時間となりました
dialogue.English: It's getting late. Our time is up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 終わりになっても大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it alright if we conclude for today?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: は、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: またよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: I look forward to our next session.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、またよろしくお願いします。終了ボタンをおさせてもらいますね。
dialogue.English: Likewise, I look forward to it. I will press the end session button now.

dialogue.content: お願いします。
dialogue.English: Please do.
